A PAUSE THAT MATTERS
Crypto moves fast.
Take a moment to check.

A wrong address, an impersonated client, a suspicious P2P trade. Once funds move, getting them back can be difficult.

TxGuard brings available blockchain activity and security reports into one readable assessment. Built for freelancers, traders and everyday crypto users.

Check the address. Understand the risk. Decide.

LESS GUESSWORK. MORE CONTEXT.

A clearer check, in three steps.

You stay in control.
TxGuard never moves your funds.

01
Enter the address

Choose the right network and paste the full recipient address. No wallet connection needed.

02
Look at the evidence

We retrieve available provider signals and blockchain data. Missing coverage stays visible.

03
Decide before you send

Review indicators, history and limitations. Independently verify the recipient before proceeding.

TxGuard assesses recipients using retrieved evidence. It cannot guarantee safety, verify ownership, recover funds, or predict execution from an address alone. Security intelligence currently covers Ethereum and BNB Chain; other networks show activity with explicit limitations.
